name: Virginia Vargas
shortBio: Peruvian feminist sociologist and theorist of transnational citizenship who shaped Latin American feminist encuentros and pluralist democratic theory.
centralQuestion: How can Latin American feminist movements sustain autonomous solidarity across class, race, and regional borders without collapsing into state co-optation?

keyWorks.title: El aporte de la rebeldía de las mujeres
keyWorks.description: Theorizes women’s autonomous political rebellion as foundational to Peruvian and Latin American democratic transformation.
